certificate.carried_meaning: top identities present in every sufficiently deep target port tuple
certificate.depth_convention: root S at depth 0; one SELF call increases depth by one
certificate.method: exact marked-table saturation and labelled subset graph
certificate.witness_schema: choose an accepting NFA run for each path prefix; attach operation/profile own marks at their introduction copies

replay.method: direct flattened-block CNF plus G at unopened calls; independent SAT projections
